data.heading: Who is Robert Khoubian?
data.short_bio: Robert Khoubian is an international food trade professional, entrepreneur and market intelligence publisher specializing in China–Eurasia food trade, frozen food supply chains and cross-border market access. Since 2004, he has worked across China, Russia and CIS markets, North America, Southeast Asia and the European Union.
data.extended_bio: Robert’s work combines commercial execution, regulatory knowledge and practical market intelligence. His experience includes international food trading, customs and veterinary requirements, Canadian government trade missions, retail product adaptation, cold-chain logistics and the development of Aquaprole Group across Canada, the United States, Singapore, China and Hong Kong.
